stories.headline: Most cross-Channel migrant small boat arrivals in single day of 2026
stories.description: A total of 781 migrants arrive on Wednesday, but the yearly total is below the same point in 2025.

stories.headline: Israel offers cash to firms hit by trade ban; Europe dithers on new rules
stories.description: Israel hopes to redirect goods from illegal Israeli settlements towards markets in Asia and South America.

stories.headline: Has China received US F-35 parts by diverting an Australian shipment?
stories.description: Australia and US investigate F-35 parts mistakenly sent to Hong Kong amid concerns over sensitive military technology.

stories.headline: Fighting widens across Ethiopia as Tigray clashes escalate
stories.description: Armed groups clashed with government forces across northern Ethiopia as fears mount of regional spillover.

stories.headline: Poland says fire at Starlink station is sabotage as Denmark warns of rising Russian threat
stories.description: The satellite station is used in part to provide internet coverage to neighbouring Ukraine, the government says.
